model.name: Structure 38
model.reason: An $F0 entrance takes its key letter from the cell it stands in, not from this record: $054CBE turns the cell's $ABDC entry byte into the $7AFB base and $059FA0 forms the label as low nybble plus base plus $23. The constructor reads only bits 8, 9 and 15, so the geometry is the same whichever path runs. Includes linked exterior/interior detail in its neutral pose. Region queues and linked detail lists recovered for on-foot drawing; each region is also offered as its own inspection form, using the detail group default list because a free-orbit view has no player position. Entrance Attachments carry constructor, slot and Proximity Box.
